document.about: Lutron Maestro fluorescent multi-location dimmer submittal sheet. Its ratings table sets the load types in a narrow column, hyphenating words at its line ends.

notes: A cell's lines joined at a line-end hyphen kept it, so a word the typesetter broke read with its hyphen inside: `Fluo-rescent Dimming Bal-lasts`. The same words are printed whole in the title and the next cells.

cell.value: 3-wire Electronic Fluorescent Dimming Ballasts (Lutron FDB, ECO, HL3, or H3D series)
